rawFindings.title: Incorrect hasNonLiteral function: misclassifies TemplateLiteral nodes as non-literals
rawFindings.explanation: The updated hasNonLiteral function no longer treats TemplateLiteral nodes as literals, which causes it to incorrectly report valid template literals as string concatenations. This breaks valid uses of template strings.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore check to include 'node.type !== "TemplateLiteral"' as a literal type, i.e., revert to: 'return node.type !== "Literal" && node.type !== "TemplateLiteral";'.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect detection of non-literal nodes in prefer-template rule
rawFindings.explanation: The function hasNonLiteral was changed to no longer consider nodes of type 'TemplateLiteral' as literals, which breaks detection of template literals in the rule and wrongly reports valid template literals as violations.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the condition to treat 'TemplateLiteral' nodes as literals by changing the return statement to: return node.type !== "Literal" && node.type !== "TemplateLiteral";

rawFindings.title: Test case removal reduces coverage of template literal handling
rawFindings.explanation: The test cases that verify correct handling of template literals in the prefer-template rule were removed, specifically tests involving template literals combined with string concatenation. This reduces confidence that the rule works correctly with template literals.
rawFindings.suggestion: Re-add the removed test cases involving template literals, including those using the ecmaFeatures flag for templateStrings, to ensure proper rule testing.

acceptedFindings.title: Test case removal reduces coverage of template literal handling
acceptedFindings.explanation: The test cases that verify correct handling of template literals in the prefer-template rule were removed, specifically tests involving template literals combined with string concatenation. This reduces confidence that the rule works correctly with template literals.
acceptedFindings.suggestion: Re-add the removed test cases involving template literals, including those using the ecmaFeatures flag for templateStrings, to ensure proper rule testing.

rawFindings.title: Incorrect detection of non-literal nodes in expression analysis
rawFindings.explanation: The change in hasNonLiteral function removes TemplateLiteral from literals considered safe. This causes nodes of type TemplateLiteral to be treated as non-literal, which is incorrect and breaks rule behavior that allows template literals as literals.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the original condition to include TemplateLiteral as a literal: return node.type !== "Literal" && node.type !== "TemplateLiteral";
